title: issue workflow allocator ignores GitHub-only BUG IDs
description: The local BUG allocator is at 216 while GitHub already contains BUG-217. A new submit-bug flow can therefore allocate a duplicate BUG-217 instead of BUG-218.
actual: Local allocator does not account for GitHub-only BUG IDs before allocating the next BUG number.
expected: BUG allocation uses max(local allocator, local BUG JSON IDs, GitHub BUG IDs) and allocates the next unused ID.
closure_requirements: Allocator considers GitHub-only BUG IDs before assigning the next BUG ID.
Simulated GitHub BUG-217 with local allocator=216 allocates BUG-218 or higher.
GitHub fallback unavailable still uses local allocator safely.
BUG JSON and GitHub Issue are synchronized.
non_goals: Do not touch production runtime services, production DB, DDL, or dependencies.

events.note: Manual safe registration because submit-bug allocator would otherwise risk BUG-217 duplication.
